candidate_evidence.title: showOpenDialog openDirectory returns canceled true on confirmed folder
candidate_evidence.excerpt: On Linux/X11, dialog.showOpenDialog({properties:['openDirectory']}) resolves {canceled:true,filePaths:[]} after choosing an existing directory and pressing Open. Expected canceled:false with the selected path.

candidate_evidence.title: Folder confirmation incorrectly returns canceled true
candidate_evidence.excerpt: On Linux/X11, confirming a selected directory in dialog.showOpenDialog with openDirectory returns canceled:true and no paths instead of canceled:false and that directory.

candidate_evidence.title: showOpenDialog openDirectory displays files
candidate_evidence.excerpt: On Linux/X11 the openDirectory picker lets me select regular files. Confirming a selected directory correctly returns canceled:false and its path.
